name: quick-edit
title: Quick edit
description: One short value edited where it stands and committed with one key (Rename, Tag): the value selected on open, Enter and Escape, the key off while empty or unchanged, the reason under the field when it is not accepted; committing, the key waits, then morphs to check and says Renamed on the drum before the plate closes, or to sync-error with Try again.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/quick-edit.md. SwiftUI: MetalQuickEdit in the MetalUI Swift package.
